title: Corpus entry permissions
description: What may be done with an entry's data. Every flag is explicit. Evaluation permission does not imply training permission, and nothing here is inferred from the data being reachable.

access_class.description: PUBLIC: redistributable under its stated license. REFERENCE_ONLY: cite and hash, never copy. SYNTHETIC: generated for this corpus. CONTROLLED_LOCAL: stays on the holder's machine; only hashes and instructions leave.

granted_by.description: Who granted these permissions, as they identify themselves. For SYNTHETIC entries generated here: 'generated for this corpus; no third-party rights'.

evidence_of_grant.description: Where the grant can be checked (a license file path, a signed agreement reference). 'NOASSERTION' when no grant exists, in which case every flag other than evaluation_allowed must be false.
